commit.message:
Gate Cloudflare Pages build on platform compliance via prebuild

Adds a `prebuild` script to web/package.json that runs
`npx @freegamestore/cli@latest check` before `vite build`. pnpm
fires prebuild automatically whenever build runs — so the
Cloudflare Pages build command (`pnpm build`) now gates on
platform compliance. A failing check aborts the build and CF
Pages skips the deploy.

This repo has no deploy.yml (CF Pages uses its built-in git
integration), so this is the only way to enforce the mandate at
deploy time.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(compliance): use correct freegamestore.online URL

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(vite): drop min_viewport_width from inline manifest

vite-plugin-pwa types reject unknown manifest fields (TS2353) and
min_viewport_width is platform-custom, not standard PWA. orientation
stays — it's a real PWA field. The central viewport-support check
treats min_viewport_width as a warn anyway, not a fail.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

deploy: gate Cloudflare Pages on platform compliance

Inserts `npx @freegamestore/cli@latest check` between `pnpm build`
and `wrangler pages deploy`. If the platform-compliance check exits
non-zero (e.g. the new PWA mandate fails), the deploy step never
runs and the broken build can't reach production.

Universal enforcement — every push to main goes through this gate
regardless of whether the repo has a separate compliance.yml.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(voice): describeMoveSpoken broken for capture-promotions + check suffix

Two voice-narration bugs found by reading the code carefully:

1. Pawn capture-promotion like "exd8=Q" was parsed wrong: the target
   detection took clean.slice(-2) AFTER stripping 'x' but BEFORE
   stripping '=Q', yielding target = "=Q". Result: voice said
   "White pawn takes on = Q, promotes to queen."

   Now strips the =X suffix first, so target correctly resolves to "d8":
   "White pawn takes on d 8, promotes to queen."

2. Check/checkmate suffix produced a stray period: any move with '+'
   or '#' had ". Check!" or ". Checkmate!" appended, then the final
   `return desc + '.'` added another period → "Check!." Cosmetic but
   wrong. Now returns early for those branches; only non-check/mate
   moves get the trailing period.

Add 6 regression tests covering pawn moves, captures, castling,
promotions (with + without capture, with + without check), and check/
checkmate suffixes. Total: 34 tests pass (was 28).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(mp): on rejected move, server sends state-snapshot so client can rollback

Two adjacent issues:

1. Client does an optimistic local chess.move() before sending to the
   server (snappy UX). If the server rejects the move (race condition:
   opponent's move arrived first), the client only gets `{type: error}`
   and never rolls back. Result: client board ahead of true state.

2. Rematch (type=new_game) handler on the client didn't clear
   selectedSquare or stale errors, so the new game inherited cursor +
   error state from the previous one.

Fix:
- Server: extract a sendState() helper. After rejecting a move
  ('Illegal', 'Not your turn', 'Game is over'), send a fresh state
  snapshot to just that client. Client already handles `type: state`
  via chess.load(fen), so optimistic moves silently roll back.
- Client: on new_game, also clear selectedSquare + error.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Billiards: 4 more bug fixes + ball-collision sound

- 8-ball + scratch is now an automatic loss. resolveShot processed the
  8-ball case and early-returned before noticing the cue ball was also
  in shotSunk, so a "win" could fire when 8-ball-rules say it's a loss.
  Now checks `s.shotSunk.includes(0)` inline; emits "8 + scratch" vs
  "Early 8" in the message.

- Pocket detection no longer misses fast straight-line shots. Was 2
  fixed substeps per frame → up to 11px movement per substep at max
  power, which can step a ball *over* a pocket (detection radius ~20).
  Substeps now scale with max ball velocity so movement never exceeds
  ~0.55 ball radii per substep (capped at 8 substeps/frame).

- AI no longer hammers every shot near max power. Old formula clamped
  to 1.0 on most paths → frequent over-shoots and scratches. New
  formula mixes path length AND cut-angle difficulty, capped at 95%
  and floored at 35%, so easy/short shots are gentle and tough cuts
  get the needed punch.

- Score popup text dropped "OPP" — color already distinguishes whose
  pile the ball counts toward (gray = opponent, yellow = own).

- Ball-vs-ball collisions now play a throttled clack sound when the
  closing-velocity component exceeds 0.35 px/ms. 70ms global cooldown
  keeps a cluster impact from spamming audio.

Billiards: fix 3 bugs in the archery aim model

- Cue stick rendered FORWARD of the cue ball at low power. The math
  `(BALL_R + 4 + pullback - 36)` produced a NEGATIVE offset until
  pullback ≥ 28 — so at 0% the tip was on the aim-line side instead
  of behind the ball. Replaced with `baseGap + pullback` so the tip
  is always behind the ball, just farther back as power rises.

- SHOOT button fired the shot if your finger drifted off it mid-hold.
  `onPointerLeave={() => releaseCharge()}` triggered on common mobile
  slip. Replaced with `setPointerCapture` on press so the button keeps
  receiving events until pointerup, and pointercancel now drops the
  charge silently instead of firing.

- Ball-in-hand placement could drop the cue ball INSIDE another ball
  (no overlap check). Added a 24-pass nudge that pushes the cue ball
  away from any overlapped ball until clear, clamped to the cushion.

than the hand-rolled grep checks did.

fix(compliance): declare orientation + --bg token

Two pre-existing central-compliance gaps that have been failing the
"Viewport support" and "Brand tokens defined" checks for the whole
game catalog:

- web/vite.config.ts inline PWA manifest now declares
  `orientation: "any"` and `min_viewport_width: 360`, so the storefront
  coverage badge has values to display and the central viewport-support
  check passes.
- web/src/index.css now defines `--bg` as an alias of `--paper`, so the
  brand-tokens check sees the game token (`--bg`) it expects for games.
  Existing rules using `var(--paper)` keep working unchanged.

Was failing the new PWA offline correctness check: index.html linked
/manifest.json but vite.config.ts had no VitePWA → service worker was
never registered → installable but couldn't load offline from home
screen. Also referenced /icons/icon-192.png and /icons/icon-512.png
that didn't exist in public/.

  - Add vite-plugin-pwa to devDeps; pnpm install regenerates lockfile.
  - Replace vite.config.ts with a full VitePWA setup — proper
    workbox config (raised cap, fonts runtime caching, wasm/json in
    globPatterns), and manifest defined inline so the plugin
    generates manifest.webmanifest at build.
  - Drop the static <link rel="manifest"> from index.html (plugin
    injects its own).
  - Delete web/public/manifest.json (plugin generates).
  - Copy icon-192.png and icon-512.png from the canonical set
    (currently held in bowling).

Preserves theme_color (#2563eb) and background_color (#ffffff)
from the prior manifest.json. Does not touch web/src/App.tsx —
left to a sibling agent's in-flight work.

Open calls: pon + chi (open melds, yaku adjusted, bot AI)

Riichi without calls was technically Mahjong-shaped solitaire. Adding pon
and chi makes hands branchy and competitive. Skipped kan — replacement
draws, dora flips, and shouminkan/ankan distinctions add a lot of corners
for marginal gameplay value.

DATA MODEL
- New OpenMeld type ({type, baseTile, called, from}). PlayerState gains
  a `melds: OpenMeld[]` field; concealed `hand` shrinks by 3 per call.
- clone / newGame / nextHand carry melds.

EVALUATOR / YAKU
- evaluateHand(concealed, openMeldCount): accepts open-meld count, validates
  concealed-tile budget = 14 - 3·count, only tries chiitoitsu / kokushi when
  fully concealed.
- isTenpai / waits gain the same openMeldCount parameter.
- detectYaku(concealed, winTile, openMelds, ctx): rebuilds the all-tile view
  from concealed + meld tiles for tile-content yaku (tanyao / honitsu /
  chinitsu); shape-driven yaku merge open + concealed melds for triplet/run
  counts (so e.g. yakuhai fires on an open pon).
- Closed-only yaku (riichi / ippatsu / menzen tsumo / pinfu / iipeikou)
  correctly skipped when melds.length > 0. Honitsu / chinitsu use the open
  variant han values.
- canDeclareRiichi blocks when any open meld exists.

CALLS
- canPon(state, seat): 2 in hand, not your own discard, not riichi-locked.
- chiOptions(state, seat): only next-seat, numbered tile, returns the
  base-tile of each possible run (handles 3 cases: tile-2,-1; tile-1,+1;
  tile,+1,+2).
- callPon / callChi: build the meld, remove the consumed tiles from hand,
  pop the called tile off the discarder's pile, jump active to caller in
  awaiting-discard, kill ippatsu globally.
- discard() now resolves bot calls in priority order: ron first, then pon.
  maybeBotPon only fires on yakuhai (dragons or matching seat/round wind)
  so bots don't pon themselves into yaku-less hands.

UI
- Open melds render to the right of the concealed hand (md size for human)
  and in the opponent rows (sm size).
- Call window: Ron / Pon / Chi / Pass buttons surface whenever the human
  has any call after a discard; the advance-after-draw timer holds the
  window open until the human picks something.
- riichiMode auto-resets when canRiichi becomes false (already existed,
  unchanged).

TESTS
- 5 new pon / chi tests: canPon detection, callPon meld + turn shift,
  chiOptions next-seat-only and base-tile enumeration, callChi tile
  removal + claim, riichi-locked players can't call. Total 33/33.

Bundle 71 KB gzip / 243 KB raw, all hard checks pass.

Multi-hand East round + bots that can win + honba/riichi sticks

Riichi as one isolated hand felt like a demo; now it's a real session.

ENGINE
- GameState gains handNumber (1..4 East), honba, riichiSticks, roundComplete.
- nextHand(state): advances dealer on non-dealer win, keeps dealer + bumps
  honba on dealer win or exhaustive draw, marks round complete past East 4.
- declareTsumoFor(state, seat) and commitRonFor(state, ronner) replace the
  hard-coded HUMAN_SEAT versions; declareTsumo/commitRon kept as thin wrappers.
- maybeBotRon(state): after every discard, scan seats in priority order
  starting at discarder+1. Stop at the human if they can ron (UI handles).
  Bots between discarder and human auto-call and win.
- botDiscard now tsumos when its hand wins before considering a discard.
- declareRiichi deposits 1000pts onto the table as a riichi stick.
- Both win paths now pay out honba (100/payer tsumo, 300 total ron) AND
  the riichi-stick pot to the winner. Result modal reports the correct
  totalPoints including bonuses.

UI
- HUD: round label is now "E-1" style with hand number, plus honba and
  stick counters when nonzero.
- Result modal: "Next hand →" or "Finish round →" depending on whether
  the next hand would push past East 4. Points use thousand-separators.
- New RoundCompleteModal: medal-ranked final scores, "Start new round"
  button that resets to East-1 honba 0.
- Reducer gains a `next-hand` action that calls into engine `nextHand`.

TESTS
- 4 new turn-flow tests cover non-dealer-win rotation, dealer-renchan
  bumping honba, the round-complete trigger past East 4, and the nextHand
  guard against being called mid-hand. Total 28/28.
